messages:
maria: noticed spike of 415s to inference-api at 09:12, concentrated to a few tenants.

jon: UA shows older SDKs (`redwood-sdk/1.1.3`) and plain `application/json`.

lee: That's the new v2 content-type enforcement. We expected some drift but not steady errors.

eva: Did we not enable the planned compatibility gate?

maria: Flag was only true in canary. prod default=false. deploy-bot: feature-flag compat.v2.auto-translate set=true for cluster-us-west at 09:18

jon: Quick mitigation: edge translator that wraps string/top-level text into v2 envelope, tag translated requests, and limit per-tenant window.

lee: Constraints: idempotence, avoid wrapping arrays, and per-tenant telemetry.

maria: Proposed heuristic: if content-type==application/json and body is string or has 'text'/'input' -> wrap into {"input": body}, set content-type to application/json+rw-v2, add header x-compat-wrapped:true, emit compat.wrap metric.

eva: Notify tenant owners (day 1,3,6) and disable auto-wrap on day 8 unless opted in. Also create dashboard showing per-tenant translated counts.

jon: Tests: unit for transform, e2e with old UA, regression for arrays. Ops plan: hotpatch edge lambda (30m), enable per-cluster, monitor metrics for 2h.

maria: I'll open PR and toggle flag for affected clusters.

deploy-bot: PR #5012 merged to main at 09:48, feature-default=false in prod.

lee: Long-term: RFC for a compat-service rather than ad-hoc edge shims. Add follow-ups in PR.

maria: Summary: short-term edge auto-wrap + telemetry + tenant notices, 1-week grace window, RFC backlog for compat-service. Posting update in #eng-infra in 2h.
